note: Sentences judged not to be payload claims. Each entry matches the normalised sentence text with re.search; the justification applies to every sentence it matches. A sentence that makes a quantified claim belongs in the claim table, not here.

entries.pattern: ^the restated strategy is valued at its gross sleeve NAV, so the parent account's unallocated cash and margin is the liability line of strategy_basis_disclosure, not this residual
entries.justification: states why a restated residual excludes the parent account's unallocated cash and margin: it follows from the restated strategy's value (gross sleeve NAV), whose amount row R22-6 asserts as sleeve value minus parent value; the residual amount itself is row R22-8

entries.pattern: ^the restated strategy is valued at its gross sleeve NAV, so the residual parent account's unallocated cash and margin is not in this residual
entries.justification: states why a residual excludes the parent account's unallocated cash and margin: it follows from the restated strategy's value (gross sleeve NAV), whose amount row R22-6 asserts as sleeve value minus parent value

entries.pattern: ^\{\}: (sleeve profit and loss after allocated costs over the prior-close sleeve NAV|the same profit over the prior-close sleeve NAV less the)

entries.pattern: ^Computed from the sleeve facts, not observed at the source: \{\} with an amount
entries.justification: the Derived measures tile subtitle: its count is the number of DERIVED rows with an amount, computed in the same function from the same rows as the tile value; S03 checks the tiles partition the rows

entries.pattern: ^parent account \{\}, not restated onto the sleeve \(capital base \{\}\)$
entries.justification: the basis label of a restated strategy's model-versus-actual windows: it names the parent account the audit input measures and the capital base the window itself carries, both inserted from the same row; it states a basis, not a quantity

entries.pattern: ^Closure not computable for the unavailable effects:$|^the producer states no number for the unavailable part\.$
entries.justification: the two halves of one static note printed under an unavailable causal bridge: it states why no closure is shown (the producer publishes no number for the unavailable part), not a quantity; the bridge shape it labels is validated by the report and panel verifiers (implementation_return_attribution tests)

entries.pattern: ^Partial: causal attribution without the connected-model mix$
entries.justification: the status label of PARTIAL_CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_MODEL_MIX_UNAVAILABLE: it names which part of the causal attribution is missing, not a quantity; the status is derived and validated by the report and panel verifiers

entries.pattern: ^not annualized: [{][}] day window [(]under 1 year[)]$
entries.justification: rendered only on the branch where the producer published no annual rate because the window is under 365 days (#904 short-window rule); the day count is the row's own window_days, computed from the same field it prints

entries.pattern: ^[(]annualized, sample std . .[(]the series' own periods a year[)], [{][}] daily observations over [{][}] days[{][}][)]$
entries.justification: label of the reconciliation tracking error: the estimator and scaling are the producer's fixed method and the count and span are the row's own observations and dates, printed from the same fields (#904 item 13)

entries.pattern: ^(no standard error: not a headline|includes hypothetical backtest: not a live result, no headline|window under a year or not a live series: no headline)$
entries.justification: rendered only when the alpha context's headline_status says the alpha is not a headline (no standard error, or a backtest in its series); the status is computed and kill-tested in test_alpha_headline_rule (#904 items 10 and 11)

entries.pattern: ^Money-weighted [(]on capital invested[)]: [{][}] over [{][}] days[{][}]$
entries.justification: readout line built from the portfolio MWR block's own window_equivalent_cumulative, window_days and value; consistent by construction and recomputed in test_portfolio_twr_conventions and test_portfolio_totals (#904 item 1)
